create_padding_sequence: create padding sequences for convolutions with given kernel size, dilation rate, and channel index
build_valid_padding: build a no-padding configuration for convolutions by calling the valid padding function
build_same_padding: build a same-padding configuration that preserves input size for stride-1 convolutions
build_causal_padding: build causal pre-padding so outputs depend only on past inputs
build_full_padding: build maximal padding configuration without convolving over padded-only elements
